notes.title: Bug fix update Ver1.04!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! I'm the creator of WiP.
This update is mainly to fix a critical bug. Thank you for your bug reports.
The details are as follows.


[b][u]Bug fixes[/u][/b].
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when performing a sliding move while charging.
[*]Fixed a bug where the background music would not disappear after restarting and returning from a pause, but would be doubled.
[*]Fixed an issue where knockback from enemy attacks on the wall to the left of the starting position would cause the wall to fall through.
[/list]

Other tweaks
[list]
[*]Downwardly revised the value of player position increase for "shoot while holding down the down key in the air".
[*]Changed system to allow punching while charging.
[/list]


If you have any existing or new fatal bugs or issues, please report them in the community or on our Youtube channel.
Thank you for your continued support of WiP, and Hinawajin!

notes.title: Recovery Items & Restart Introduced! Update Ver1.03!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! I am the creator of WiP.
In this update, we've implemented recovery items and restarts!
The details are as follows.


[b][u]Recovery Items[/u][/b].
Some enemy characters will now drop items that restore HP and MP!
Two types of recovery items, large and small, will drop!

[b][u]Restart[/u][/b].
Pressing the Jump & Decide button on the pause screen will take you back to the title screen.
Pressing the pause button again will restart the game without going to the title screen.


Other Tweaks
[list].
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when punching while charging.
/list]

If you have any existing or new fatal glitches or bugs, please report them in the community or on our Youtube channel.


With the exception of bug fixes, the next update is expected to be delayed.
We have decided to fundamentally revamp the game by revising the graphics and structure of all currently playable stages, and adding new enemies.
We will make further efforts to make the game more enjoyable for all players.
Please subscribe to our game production Youtube channel "[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoB1nGQtPn0GMbm2ldpuD9Q]【ゲーム制作】World in Progress[/url]" and spread the word on SNS!

We look forward to your continued support for WiP and Hinawajin!

notes.title: Key config & charge shot introduced! Update 1.02!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! I am Hinawajin, the creator of WiP.
First of all, I'd like to apologize for my long absence from the update process due to personal reasons.
My motivation is improving and my health is improving, so I will try my best to increase the frequency and quality of updates in the future.

In this update, we've added key configs and implemented charge shots!
The details are as follows.


[b][u]Key Config[/u][/b] Allows you to change two types of buttons: keyboard and gamepad.

・[u][b]Charge Shot[/b][/u].
Press and hold the Shoot button to start charging.
By releasing the button when fully charged, you can unleash a "Charge Shot" that consumes 10 MP and deals 10 times the damage of normal bullets!
Currently, you can only use around 10 shots of this great technique, but we plan to implement a recovery item that will drop when enemies are defeated in a future update!


Other Tweaks
[list]
[*]Fixed the phenomenon that the window shifts to the upper left when returning to the title screen.
[*]Changed default Jump button to Z, Punch button to X, and Shoot button to C.
[*]Changed the player character's MP to automatically recover continuously.
[*]Decreased the damage of normal bullets fired by the Shoot button and increased the rate of fire.
[/list].

If you have any existing or new fatal bugs or issues, please report them to the community or Youtube channel.


There is one announcement here.
A channel dedicated to game production, "[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoB1nGQtPn0GMbm2ldpuD9Q][u][b]【ゲーム制作】World in Progress[/b][/u][/url]", has just been launched on Youtube!
We will be doing videos about game production in general, and live streaming of WiP updates in real time!
If you are interested, please subscribe to our channel and spread the word on SNS!

Thank you for your continued support of WiP and Hinawajin!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 1.01!
notes.notes:
Hello to all the players! This is the creator of "WiP".
In response to the bug report, the update will focus on fixing the fatal bug.
The content is as follows.


[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a game error that occurred when attacking and jumping at the same time.
[*]Fixed a phenomenon in which a sudden descent (after jumping in the air, jump + ↓) towards a wall can be performed again without falling.
[*]Fixed a problem where the player character would slip through walls and go out of the screen.
[/list]


We're checking now.
[list]
[*] Some enemy characters ignore the stage structure and chase the player.
[*] When returning to the title screen after game over or game clear, the window shifts to the upper left.
[/list]
We apologize for the delay in responding to this issue, as the possibility has arisen that the foundation of the system needs to be rewritten.

Thank you for your continued support of WiP and the Hinawajin.
